purpose: 45万円以内のPC一式購入に向けたCPU/GPU価格・在庫・電力効率・AI適性の比較。購入・注文・決済・予約は実行しない。

cpu.interpretation: 同一配点で比較。Cities: Skylines II等のシミュレーション、制作・分析、消費電力、購入目標価格、AM5継続性、販売証拠を評価。

gpu.interpretation: WQHD性能スコア、CUDA/ROCm/oneAPIの実用互換性、VRAM、性能スコア÷TGPの効率proxy、購入目標価格、保証/在庫証拠を評価。

score_policy.performance_per_watt_proxy: 2026-11-11 GPU comparison score divided by published TGP; not a measured wall-power benchmark
score_policy.provisional_unknown_price_rule: 価格が未確認の候補はprice_vs_targetを中立7/15とし、必ず暫定と明記する。
score_policy.note: Daily CPU/GPU comparison scores are distinct from the repository's existing full-build score, component fit score and dynamic purchase-evidence score. Do not compare these scales as if they measure the same thing.
score_policy.evidence_completeness_score_definition: Separate 0-100 confidence score: exact model identity, direct current product page, current price, stock, seller, shipping, delivery, warranty/return terms, and for used cards physical-condition and operating-test evidence. It does not change the hardware-fit score.

performance_and_power.source: ComputerBase RX 9070/9070 XT review and RTX 5060 Ti 16GB review; 2026-11-11 repository GPU comparison index for TGP-normalized proxy
performance_and_power.proxy_note: GPU comparison score divided by published TGP; not measured FPS/W. Actual board power differs by test, model and workload.
performance_and_power.annual_cost_note: Component-only GPU estimate, 3 hours/day x 365 days x ¥31/kWh; not whole-PC wall power. WQHD RTX 5060 Ti uses the 169W ComputerBase test value; RX9070/XT and RTX5070/Ti use measured gaming values.
performance_and_power.system_wall_power: not measured; do not infer whole-PC draw from component TDP/TGP
performance_and_power.noise_and_temperature: Partner-card temperatures/noise not directly measured in this run; do not assign a universal dBA or temperature.

decision.cpu: 9700X remains the best efficiency/value choice at 44,800 yen; it is 4,800 yen above the 40,000 yen target. 9800X3D remains the simulation-first alternative at 71,800 yen. 9850X3D fell to 79,443 yen but still costs 7,643 yen more than 9800X3D.
decision.gpu: RTX 5060 Ti 16GB at 144,980 yen is the strongest currently verified balanced CUDA/16GB/180W budget option. RTX 5070 Ti 16GB is the highest combined fit but too expensive. RX 9070 is attractive on price/performance efficiency but its current stock and price were not revalidated today. RX 9070 XT Challenger at 159,800 yen is over target and consumes 304W.
decision.best_current_build: 9700X + RTX 5060 Ti 16GB + 32GB RAM + 2TB SSD, planning estimate ¥434,148, remaining ¥15,852; not checkout-verified.
